text:
lia: Heads up — console showed a surge of fncall validation failures for prod-eu this morning. Billing looks weird too, small customer impacted but huge token charge spike.

lia: sample log snippet:
```
[2026-03-20T10:12:33Z] warn invoke: fncall validation failed: expected object 'result', got array
payload={\"user_id\":\"u_42\",\"request_id\":\"r-abc123\"}
route=prod-eu; routed_to=variant-v1; fallback=degen
```

samir: saw this. telemetry shows ~4x validation.fail_count after we flipped strict schema for fncall in prod-eu canary yesterday :grimacing:

maya: are these failures causing the requests to be routed to degen? and are we double-billing because fallback triggers a full invoke? @alex

alex: yes -> our router falls back to degen-variant when schema rejects. billing currently counts the full invoke on the fallback path (we treat it like a retry). that's what caused the spike.

katie: console only shows aggregate "fncall rejects" and "fallbacks" — we don't surface the original validation error on the per-route dashboard. ops can't debug who sent arrays vs objects.

jon: quick idea: add a header from validator that annotates the route decision, e.g. `X-Redwood-Validate: strict|soft` and `X-Redwood-Validate-Err: type_mismatch` so router + billing can tag the event without recomputing. small change in agent side.

samir: good. also we should add telemetry labels: `validation.fail_type` and `route.fallback_reason` so dashboards can pivot.

maya: policy question: should a failed validation that triggers fallback count against the customer's fncall quota? SDK folks say yes because compute happened. Billing ops says feels wrong for malformed payloads.

alex: product stance: malformed payloads are still user traffic. short-term: count them but display a separate "validation charge" line item in console so customers can see clarity.

katie: console UX: add a row in per-route table for last_validation_error with sample payload link (redact PII). Also add a K/V filter for `validation.fail_type` so SREs can slice.

ops-bot: [ALERT] 4765432109 - validation.fail_rate > 0.8% in prod-eu (5m window). Triggered runbook: notify eng-platform oncall.

jon: implementation note: I'll prototype the header and router tagging. snippet idea:
```
# validator side
if not matches_schema(payload):
  resp.headers['X-Redwood-Validate'] = 'strict'
  resp.headers['X-Redwood-Validate-Err'] = 'expected_object_got_array'
  return validation_error
```

samir: for telemetry sampling, tag 100% for failures, 1% for successes. we need enough failure samples to show spike context.

maya: action items:
- jon -> PR to add headers + router tag (ETA 48h)
- samir -> telemetry labels + dashboard card prototype (ETA 72h)
- alex -> draft console billing line + copy for billing page (ETA EOW)
- katie -> design quick filter & last_error column (sync Tue)

mia: (typo) meant maya above.

lia: thanks all. putting this on the ops runbook to avoid surprise charges. will follow up once router patch merges :thumbsup:
